fields.climate: Mediterranean; mild to cool, wet winters with hot, dry summers; the Lebanon Mountains experience heavy winter snows
fields.terrain: narrow coastal plain; El Beqaa (Bekaa Valley) separates Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon Mountains
fields.resources: limestone, iron ore, salt, water-surplus state in a water-deficit region, arable land
fields.farm: potatoes, milk, tomatoes, apples, oranges, olives, cucumbers/gherkins, chicken, lemons/limes, wheat
fields.exports: jewelry, cars, diamonds, scrap iron, gold
fields.industries: banking, tourism, real estate and construction, food processing, wine, jewelry, cement, textiles, mineral and chemical products, wood and furniture products, oil refining, metal fabricating
fields.religions: Muslim 67.8% (31.9% Sunni, 31.2% Shia, smaller percentages of Alawites and Ismailis), Christian 32.4% (Maronite Catholics are the largest Christian group), Druze 4.5%, very small numbers of Jews…

independence.from: League of Nations mandate under French administration

fields.legal: mixed system of civil law based on the French civil code, Ottoman legal tradition, and religious laws covering personal status, marriage, divorce, and other family relations of the Jewish, Islamic…
fields.suffrage: 21 years of age; authorized for all men and women regardless of religion…
fields.military: 18-25 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
